specifications.gate_noise: replacement depolarizing D_eps after every gate (draft Eq. noisy_entangling_channel); eps1=eps2/10 in the reference; eps3=eps2
specifications.cswap: compiled CNOT(b->a) layer, M Toffolis CCX(c,a->b), CNOT layer (M+2 units)
specifications.idle: amplitude damping idle_gamma and Z flip idle_phi per unit on every waiting data and control qubit
specifications.clock: gates 1 unit; t_prep/t_meas/t_reset; just-in-time preparation; no feed-forward; ancilla reuse waits for measure+reset+H
specifications.resets: first use perfect; every actual mid-circuit reuse pays t_reset and the reset error
specifications.readout: independent classical flip of each recorded ancilla outcome
specifications.source_noise: Pauli-form local depolarizing source_pauli_p for abstract sources; algorithm circuits use the gate noise above
specifications.measurement: ideal projective O on the measured register(s)
specifications.vcp: order-2 Liu-style VCP on the gate support of every layer that contains a two-qubit gate (one-qubit-only layers unpurified, eps1=eps2/10); a fresh control (and auxiliary I/2^k) per purified layer from the smallest round-robin pool that keeps measurement/reset off the main register critical path
specifications.derangement: wide controlled cyclic shift, O on all N registers averaged (Koczor cyclic derangement); each spent register read out mid-circuit right after its CSWAP (t_meas; observable readouts ideal as in every arm); dense, 1+MN<=9
specifications.study_circuits: algorithm_blocks M=2: entangling L=12 (first 12 layers of U_B^2 U_A), product L=8 (U_B^3 U_A); M=1 entangling L=6
specifications.p_conventions: pauli_form (1-p)rho+p/3 sum P rho P: sources, local depolarizing; replacement_form (1-p)rho+p I/D: global depolarizing, gate noise eps; z_flip (1-p)rho+p Z rho Z: dephasing
